data.name: Krithika
data.long_meaning: The name Krithika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kritika', which means 'the tenth', 'the one who sees' or 'the constellation Ursa Major'. In Hindu mythology, the constellation Ursa Major is believed to be a representation of the goddess Kritika, who is considered the goddess of stars and constellations. She is also believed to be the goddess of the harvest and the giver of knowledge.

data.cultural_impact: The name Krithika has its origins in Hindu mythology and carries a rich cultural significance. Krithika is associated with the constellation Ursa Major and symbolizes the numerological number ten. This association can be traced back to many ancient texts and scripts of Hinduism that attribute various mythological and cultural meanings to stars and constellations. In Indian astrology, the constellation Ursa Major shows the path and deity for the month of Chaitra. Due to its mythological and cultural associations, the name Krithika is considered auspicious in Indian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name Krithika is believed to be a spiritual name of Goddess Kritika, also known as 'Revati'. She is identified as Saadhvi, Saraswati, and Mahamaya. As the goddess of stars and constellations, Krithika is believed to have the power to grant knowledge and wisdom, abundance, prosperity, good fortune, and protection. The name also signifies the power of seeing the truth and understanding the intricacies of the universe. In spiritual practices, Krithika represents the inner light of consciousness that illuminates the path to enlightenment. Overall, Krithika is a powerful and auspicious name in Hindu mythology and culture, carrying both cultural and spiritual significance.
